TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() gets pricingRuleId and pricingRuleRequest, reads the request header user code as auditUserId, and ABKOR001Impl.executePutPricingRules loads the current rule with getPricingRuleById, loads active details with getDetailsByRuleId, copies them into existing.setDetails(mapDetails(oldDetails)), validates the requested startDate with UtilDates.validateActivationDate, checks duplicate candidates with PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPut, and resolves each requested detail value with PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues. 2. Decisions and branches: if getPricingRuleById returns null, executePutPricingRules adds advice ABKO10000405 and returns null; if existing status is SYC, hasActiveChildren(id) is true, or restricted synchronized fields change, PricingRuleValidator throws validation errors; if duplicate validation finds a conflicting candidate or payment-method overlap, it throws duplicate errors; if existing.getStatus() == StatusEnum.SYC, handleSycUpdate creates a new version, otherwise syncDetails inserts or deactivates detail rows and updatePricingRule updates the current rule. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() calls ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules, which uses PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById, getDetailsByRuleId, hasActiveChildren, fillDetailValues, syncDetails, deactivateDetail, getNextId, insertAudit, insertPricingRule, and insertDetails; uses PricingRuleValidator.validatePut and PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPut; and uses PricingRuleMapper.mapRowToDto and mapToInsert to map database rows and persistence parameters. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: executePutPricingRules emits ABKO10000405 when existing == null; PricingRuleValidator.validatePut throws ABKO10000407 when actual.getActive() is false, ABKO10000408 when status is not PAA, PAU, REJ, SYE, or SYC, ABKO10000417 when status is SYC and hasActiveChildren is true, ABKO10000413 when UtilDates.validateActivationDate(updated.getEffectiveDate()) is false, and ABKO10000414 when restrictedUpdate and hasRestrictedForbiddenChanges(actual, updated) are both true; PutPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.validatePricingRuleType throws ABKO10000416 when pricingRuleType is not V, R, or P; UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPricingRuleAlreadyExists throws ABKO10010401 when a duplicate candidate matches; UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPaymentMethodOverlap throws ABKO10010415 when a variable rule overlaps on payment method; PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when the lookup query is missing, returns blank, or raises NoResultException; PricingRuleRepository.deactivateDetail throws ABKO00000010 when updateResult == 0, updatePricingRule adds advice ABKO00000010 when result == 0, executePutPricingRules converts PricingRuleException to addAdviceWithDescription, and execute() sets severity EWR when getAdviceList() is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: on success executePutPricingRules returns the same pricingRule DTO after setting id, optional comments or type defaults, detail values, status PAU, and parent or version data, and execute() always calls setPricingruleresponse(pricingRule); when ABKOR001 returns null because of not found or validation errors, setPricingruleresponse is still called with null.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Modifies a pricing rule by loading the current record, validating status and duplicate constraints, resolving detail values, and then updating the current rule or creating a new SYC version with its detail records.
